suite: Equivalent under conditions: VeriEQL LeetCode (every 8th case)
score: 532 cases proved only under conditions beyond the declared ones, 0 wrong
metric: Of 3,000 cases (every eighth of 23,994), the 1,546 the prover does not prove outright with the spec's own types, keys, NOT NULL columns and foreign keys (1,454 are proved outright): 532 proved under a minimal set of extra NOT NULL, unique-key and foreign-key conditions, 1,014 unknown (998 with no proof, and 16 conditional proofs the executed check cannot re-check (not scored: 7 rest on a composite foreign key it cannot impose, 7 hold only when a column is NOT NULL and make both queries constant on every test database, and 2 are pairs the test databases cannot run).
correctness: 0 wrong, 0 crashed: every conditional proof passed the executed counterexample search with its conditions added to the spec (300 databases, then 300 wider ones) with no difference; the prover loses each proof when any one condition is dropped; 196 are separated by a database that breaks the conditions
caveats: A sample, not the whole set (3,000 of 23,994 cases). Proof under assumed conditions beyond the declared ones. No held-out split reserved; the harness was developed against Singh dev pairs and an early 80-case sample (tuned on test). Conditions beyond the spec are rarer than on the Singh pairs because the declared keys already carry what the prover can use. Measured 2026-11-12 on commit 395b5c1 (hardest-cases batch 3, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 20), with main 0e94662 measured the same way on the same sample as the baseline (879 outright, 335 conditional, 1,781 unknown, 5 not re-checkable): no pair moved the other way; 50 unknown pairs became outright proofs, 39 unknown pairs conditional, and two pairs that a database separated before (they differ only on a row whose column is NULL) now read as conditional on that column being NOT NULL and are not re-checkable. On the first measurement (2026-10-04) the count was 297. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on 9dadccb, the fourth and fifth hardest-cases batches (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 38) on main 2cf0154: 1,196 outright, 413 conditional, 1,380 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Main's prover (711a01b) measured the same way on the same sample: 1,189 outright, 379 conditional, 1,422 unknown, 10 not re-checkable; the distance from the 374 recorded on 2026-11-12 comes from rule batches merged in between and was not traced here. Compared case by case with that run: 36 unknown cases became conditional, 5 unknown cases and 2 conditional ones became outright proofs, 1 unknown case became a conditional proof that is not re-checkable (not scored), 4 conditional proofs name a different minimal set, and no proof is lost. 23 of the 36 read the sales table, 4 the insurance table, and the rest salesperson, orders, views and employee tables. The 413 use 593 conditions (456 NOT NULL, 120 unique, 17 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (289, 87, 25, 7, 3, 2 proofs). The batches' rules were written on development pairs of the Singh conditional eval, which holds some of the same LeetCode problems; this sample was run for scoring and its cases were not read. Measured on 9dadccb, before main's date fix for counterexamples (b8df3d5) was merged. Rerun later on 2026-11-17 on 7945aa7 (the sixth batch, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 40, on main edb3ae3, which holds the date fix): every one of the 3,000 cases has the same verdict and the same conditions, and all 413 passed the executed search again. The sixth batch's rule fired in this sample and moved nothing. Re-measured on 2026-11-18 on b39b665 (the seventh batch, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 41, on main caee6e3): 1,197 outright, 430 conditional, 1,362 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Compared case by case with the run on 7945aa7: 17 unknown cases became conditional and 1 became an outright proof, the other 2,982 have the same verdict and the same conditions, and no proof is lost. The batch's rule reads a declared or assumed foreign key as "the referenced row is there", and this sample's specs declare foreign keys, so it also acts on them: 15 of the 17 name a foreign key beyond the spec (12 of them from the product table to the sales table, "every product has a sale") and 2 name only a NOT NULL column beside a foreign key the spec declares. All 430 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 430 use 643 conditions (490 NOT NULL, 121 unique, 32 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (291, 88, 36, 9, 4, 2 proofs). The new outright proof rests on foreign keys the spec declares; it was read and replayed on 1,200 generated databases that meet the spec with no difference, which is the one case of this sample that was read. 2026-11-18 (truth values read as 1 or 0, issue 42, merged after that measurement): a scan of the pairs that compare a truth value with something found one case of this sample (leetcode:8056) whose pair is now counted by the harness where it was not before, and none lost; the sample was not rerun with that change alone. Re-measured later on 2026-11-18 on e203738 (the eighth and ninth batches, Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 44, on main f6585e0, which holds the truth-value change): 1,209 outright, 465 conditional, 1,315 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong, about 72 minutes. Compared case by case with the run on b39b665, 57 cases differ and no proof is lost; each of the 57 was also decided on main f6585e0 to tell the two changes apart. The truth-value change alone gives 7 new outright proofs and 1 new conditional one (leetcode:8056), so main stands at 1,204 and 431 on these cases (the 2,943 cases that did not differ were not decided on main). The two batches give the rest: 36 unknown cases became conditional, 3 unknown cases and 2 conditional ones became outright proofs, and 8 conditional proofs name another minimal set (6 one condition fewer, 1 two fewer, 1 a different set of the same size). The 36 name 54 NOT NULL and 21 unique-key conditions and no foreign key. All 465 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 465 use 711 conditions (544 NOT NULL, 135 unique, 32 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (303, 101, 46, 9, 4, 2 proofs). The 5 new outright proofs were each replayed on 1,200 generated databases that meet the spec with no difference; the 2 outside the held-out fifth (index divisible by 5) were also read, which makes 3 cases of this sample read in all. Not in the count: the VeriEQL worker rules (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 36), measured on e75c9a3 (main edb3ae3 without batches 6 and 7): 1,395 outright, 394 conditional, 1,200 unknown, 11 not re-checkable, 0 wrong; the proofs together 1,789 (main edb3ae3: 1,609; main with batch 7: 1,627). Not compared case by case, not rerun on batches 6 and 7. 2026-11-18, the merge with main c97feeb (the worker rules, PR 36, and the derived-table rounding fix, PR 46; commit 873f667): the whole sample was not repeated, so the counts above are still the run on e203738. Decided again with the whole harness: the 57 cases that changed in that run, on the first merge (17d717b, main fab9ed0), each with the same verdict and the same conditions; and the 693 cases that hold a division or an average, the only ones the rounding fix can read differently, on 873f667. Of the 693, the 195 proofs (166 outright, 29 conditional) keep their verdicts and conditions, 466 stay unknown, and 32 unknown cases are now proved (20 outright, 12 under conditions), which is main's worker rules at work and is not in the count. No proof is lost and none is wrong. Re-measured on 2026-11-19 (whole run in 12 parts, 4 cores, about 110 minutes) on c7d7021, the tenth hardest-cases batch (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 48: shares and percentages) on main 4395845, which holds the worker rules (PR 36), the derived-table rounding fix (PR 46) and the declared-decimals check (PR 49): 1,433 outright, 470 conditional, 1,084 unknown, 13 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. This is the first whole run with the worker rules in it. Compared case by case with the run on e203738: 287 cases differ and no proof is lost (171 unknown cases became outright proofs, 58 conditional, 2 conditional and not re-checkable, 53 conditional proofs became outright, and 3 conditional proofs name another set). Each of the 287 was also decided on main 4395845 to tell the batch from the changes main already holds. 219 have on main the answer and the conditions of this run (145 unknown cases outright, 19 conditional, 52 conditional ones outright, 3 with another set): that is the worker rules, so main stands at 1,406 outright and 440 conditional on these cases. The other 68 are the batch: 18 unknown cases became outright proofs (13 development, 5 held out by index divisible by 5), 39 became conditional (32 and 7), 9 development cases that main proves only under conditions are proved outright, and 2 development cases became conditional proofs that are not re-checkable (not scored). The 2,713 cases that did not differ were not decided on main, except the four slowest unknown ones, which main also leaves unknown; no search of this run came near its 600-second limit except one case that takes main as long. Of the 68, 37 read the delivery table (the share of immediate orders), 20 the activity table (the fraction of players who came back the day after their first login), 10 the queries table (quality and the percentage of poor queries) and 1 a table of numbers. The 39 conditional ones name 72 NOT NULL and 3 unique-key conditions, two conditions for 36 of them and one for 3. All 470 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 470 use 756 conditions (611 NOT NULL, 119 unique, 26 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (271, 135, 49, 9, 4, 2 proofs). The batch's rules were written on cases of this sample outside the held-out fifth (the 373 development cases with a division or an average that were unknown before it), so those are tuned on; the held-out fifth was scored only and never read, and it holds 286 outright and 98 conditional proofs of its 600 cases. Re-measured on 2026-11-20 (whole run in 12 parts, 4 cores, about 138 minutes) on 6fedbbc, the eleventh hardest-cases batch (Kumo_SQL_Prover PR 50, on main 3f63c5a: sums of tests, sums of additions, a GROUP BY name two joined tables share): 1,454 outright, 532 conditional, 998 unknown, 16 not re-checkable, 0 wrong. Compared case by case with the run on c7d7021 (main's prover), 86 cases differ and no proof is lost: 21 unknown cases became outright proofs (13 development, 8 held out by index divisible by 5), 62 became conditional (49 and 13), and 3 development cases became conditional proofs that are not re-checkable (not scored); the other 2,914 have the same verdict and the same conditions. The batch's rules run only after the earlier stages of a proof end without a verdict and only on a query one of them would rewrite. A scan for those queries (under the declared facts, with every column NOT NULL, and with every column and pair of columns a key) names 305 of the 3,000 cases (283 where a rule fires, 22 where the scan failed and which are counted as touched); all 86 are among them, and the 305 decided alone on 6fedbbc before the whole run gave the answers and conditions of the whole run. Of the 305, the 42 outright and 56 conditional proofs main has stay with the same conditions and 121 stay unknown. The 21 outright proofs were each replayed on 1,200 further generated databases that meet the spec, with no difference. By table: 21 conditional proofs read the sales table (buyers of one product and not another, products sold only in a period), 16 the championships table (15 conditional, 1 outright), 13 customers and orders, 11 outright proofs prices and units sold, 10 conditional ones boxes and chests, 6 outright ones the employees table, and 6 others spending, queries and activity. The 62 name 125 NOT NULL, 10 unique-key and 3 foreign-key conditions; one condition for 24, two for 17, three for 6, four for 14 and six for 1. All 532 passed the executed search (300 databases, then 300 wider ones). The 532 use 894 conditions (736 NOT NULL, 129 unique, 29 foreign key); conditions per proof 1 to 6 (295, 152, 55, 23, 4, 3 proofs). Cost: the 305 touched cases took 7,668 seconds of proof time against 3,518 on c7d7021 (the batch is a further stage of the proof and of every candidate set the condition search tries), the other 2,695 took 24,335 against 22,092 on a machine that was restarted twice during the run. The rules were written on development cases of this sample (tuned on); the held-out fifth was scored only and never read, and it holds 294 outright and 111 conditional proofs of its 600 cases.
